_comment_layout: Reference workflow spec — load with serde_json into tenzro_workflow::Workflow. workflow_id, obligation ids, and gate_id are 32-byte hash arrays; placeholders here MUST be re-derived at load time via Workflow::derive_id / Obligation::derive_id / ApprovalGate::derive_id. The accompanying autonomous_procurement_daml_map.json drives DAML codegen.
_comment_scenario: Autonomous procurement between a buyer-controlled agent and a seller-controlled agent: buyer agent agrees to pay USDC to seller agent in exchange for delivery of a credentialed resource. Treasurer gates the spend if the cart amount exceeds 50,000 USDC (1-of-1 approval). Auditor receives unredacted receipts via the privacy domain. Mirrored to a Canton synchronizer for enterprise settlement.
creator: did:tenzro:human:buyer-org:1
title: autonomous_procurement
description: Two-sided autonomous procurement: buyer-agent pays USDC, seller-agent delivers a credentialed resource. Treasurer-gated for spends > 50k USDC; auditor receives full receipts.

_obligation_records._comment: Buyer-agent pays seller-agent. amount_wei is in USDC's 6-decimal base units expressed as wei-equivalent — host normalizes against asset.symbol.
Seller-agent delivers a credentialed resource. discharge_proof_required = Credential — the seller submits a W3C Verifiable Credential attesting delivery, verified against the obligor's TDIP wallet.

approval_gates._comment_id: Derived at load time via ApprovalGate::derive_id(workflow_id, 'high_value_spend').

_comment_privacy_domain: Set at load time via PrivacyDomainRegistry::register with visibility = MembersPlusAuditors so the auditor receives unredacted receipts. Members = the 6 participants above.
_comment_fee_route: Set at load time. Suggested split: 80% seller-agent, 15% buyer-org treasury, 5% Tenzro network fee (per default 0.5% applied to the buyer-side leg, 4.5% protocol margin retained at fee-route level).
